qualification_contract.scope: Current-machine integrated authenticated pose replication, deterministic semantic faults, real ordered TLS delay/partition/reconnect, recipient privacy, bounded history and sampled process resources; full CPU/sanitizer and protected dependency/package qualification.
resolved_development_findings: The first focused process attempt passed baseline, both RTT/loss profiles and partition recovery, then correctly failed slow-reader recovery. Its pause trigger ran before state receipt and missed the pending ACK created later in the same loop. Moving the trigger after state application and before ACK admission exercised the intended unchanged 700 ms read pause against the unchanged 500 ms ACK deadline. The failed receipt is retained; later focused and full runs must qualify corrected inputs.

A Windows resource-reader diagnostic caught normal exit racing a sample. Startup and post-cleanup live checkpoints now use explicit parent acknowledgements; monitoring stops at the final checkpoint and holds the owned Windows process handle. This measures sampled working-set RSS/handles, not allocator overhead or lifetime leak freedom.
limits: Two local enrolled recipients, 66 candidate actors and 32 authorized poses each. Baseline/partition/slow/hostile advance 120 source ticks at 20 Hz; both RTT profiles advance 320 ticks. This is not full 16-player LOCAL-MMO-1, gameplay, regional transfer or production capacity.

Semantic message loss 1%/5%, duplication 50%, reorder 30% and 1500 ms reorder delay operate on authenticated decoded state, using seeds 1/1337 and replayed input timestamps. The opaque relay preserves TLS byte FIFO with 50/100 ms one-way delay and 0..30 ms seeded jitter; these are not TCP packet-loss or WAN measurements.

Actual partition withholds bounded bytes for at least 500 ms, closes both relay sockets and requires authenticated reconnection. The slow-reader fixture pauses polling 700 ms and crosses the 500 ms application ACK deadline. Neither grants uncertain operations by guessing session sequence.

Sampled per-process acceptance ceilings are 1 GiB resident memory and 512 handles/file descriptors; 10 ms observations include startup and post-cleanup live checkpoints. They are not OS-enforced limits or bounds on unsampled peaks, allocator/TLS/kernel overhead or production memory.

Retained capacity counts cover declared engine vector storage. The compact versioned receipt retains derived resource values plus canonical sample hashes and raw receipt paths/hashes; complete raw measurements remain under ignored out/.

Public/bootstrap executables still expose no player listener or playable world. CPU authoring adapters, persistence, combat/prediction and seamless regional transfer retain their later owners. Windows development tools remain installed; WSL userspaces share this PC/kernel.

commands.name: tls-sanitizer-compilation
command:
import hashlib, json, shlex
from pathlib import Path
rows = []
for build in (Path('/work/build-05a-final/server-asan-ubsan'),
              Path('/work/build-05a-final-client/linux-asan-ubsan')):
    path = build / 'compile_commands.json'
    entries = json.loads(path.read_text())
    c_units = [entry for entry in entries if Path(entry['file']).suffix == '.c']
    assert len(c_units) == 116, f'Unexpected TLS C compiler units: {build}'
    for entry in c_units:
        assert '/_deps/mbedtls-src/' in entry['file'], entry['file']
        arguments = entry.get('arguments') or shlex.split(entry['command'])
        assert Path(arguments[0]).name == 'clang-18', arguments[0]
        assert '-fsanitize=address,undefined' in arguments, entry['file']
        assert '-fno-omit-frame-pointer' in arguments, entry['file']
    required = {
        'engine/core/src/net_interest.cpp', 'tests/net_interest_tests.cpp',
        'tests/net_interest_probe.cpp', 'engine/core/src/net_replication.cpp',
        'engine/core/src/net_replication_wire.cpp', 'tests/core_net_replication_tests.cpp',
        'tests/core_net_replication_wire_tests.cpp', 'tests/replication_probe.cpp',
        'engine/core/src/net_transport.cpp', 'engine/core/src/net_session.cpp',
        'engine/core/src/net_session_wire.cpp', 'tests/core_net_mtls_tests.cpp',
        'tests/core_net_session_tests.cpp', 'tests/session_probe.cpp',
    }
    required.update(json.loads('["tests/net_adversity_tests.cpp", "tests/net_adversity_probe.cpp"]'))
    owned = [entry for entry in entries
             if any(entry['file'].endswith('/' + name) for name in required)]
    assert len(owned) == len(required), f'Missing instrumented network units: {build}'
    for entry in owned:
        arguments = entry.get('arguments') or shlex.split(entry['command'])
        assert Path(arguments[0]).name == 'clang++-18', arguments[0]
        assert '-fsanitize=address,undefined' in arguments, entry['file']
        assert '-fno-omit-frame-pointer' in arguments, entry['file']
    rows.append({'build': str(build), 'status': 'PASS',
                 'tls_c_translation_units': len(c_units),
                 'owned_network_translation_units': len(owned),
                 'owned_network_sources': sorted(required),
                 'compiler': 'clang-18', 'sanitizers': ['address', 'undefined'],
                 'compile_commands_sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
print(json.dumps(rows, indent=2))

resolved_development_findings: The first focused process attempt passed baseline, both RTT/loss profiles and partition recovery, then correctly failed slow-reader recovery. Its pause trigger ran before state receipt and missed the pending ACK created later in the same loop. Moving the trigger after state application and before ACK admission exercised the intended unchanged 700 ms read pause against the unchanged 500 ms ACK deadline. The failed receipt is retained; later focused and full runs must qualify corrected inputs.

A Windows resource-reader diagnostic caught normal exit racing a sample. Startup and post-cleanup live checkpoints now use explicit parent acknowledgements; monitoring stops at the final checkpoint and holds the owned Windows process handle. This measures sampled working-set RSS/handles, not allocator overhead or lifetime leak freedom.
limits: Two local enrolled recipients, 66 candidate actors and 32 authorized poses each. Baseline/partition/slow/hostile advance 120 source ticks at 20 Hz; both RTT profiles advance 320 ticks. This is not full 16-player LOCAL-MMO-1, gameplay, regional transfer or production capacity.
